intent.completion: A permission-compatible reusable caller with preserved publication gating and locally verified generation/preparation/HTTP/database behavior.

stages: unpublished preparation + deployed assets + HTTP/database smoke
compatible real publication export + renderer + preparation + smoke
packaged release application checks in both states

retained_enquiry_qualification.assertions: Database record equals the seeded full-field expectation before and after smoke in both states; authenticated HTTP renders contact, request, submission timestamp and follow-up. CSRF denial writes no enquiry; anonymous staff access is denied; a fresh enquiry persists exact fields; real magic-link login creates the session used for staff reads. CSS is fetched nonempty, including deployed digested app assets. Source and history metadata integrity are checked in SQL, not claimed as separately rendered UI fields.
retained_enquiry_qualification.limitations: Synthetic data and local sessions, disabled outbound mail; Contacted does not prove a reply or achievement of the customer goal.
